worldcombat.skill.sweetscent.summary: Spit a lingering cloud of sweet aroma at a chosen spot; anyone inside is drenched in scent so every hit on them from any source lands harder.
worldcombat.skill.sweetscent.use.0: Turn an area into a vulnerability zone
worldcombat.skill.sweetscent.use.1: Focus fire an enemy the cloud has covered
worldcombat.skill.sweetscent.description: A drenched target gains %1$s rank(s) of Scented and keeps the aroma for %2$s after leaving the cloud; each rank amplifies all damage dealt to it by 6%.
The cloud radius is %1$s, lingers %2$s and scents up to %3$s bodies per scan.
worldcombat.skill.sweetscent.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
On: a heavier aroma — +1 Scent rank, longer lingering and a longer cloud, at the cost of a smaller radius and a slightly longer cooldown. Off: lighter — wider coverage but one notch less concentration and duration.
Beyond this distance the companion walks closer before spraying; larger means it commits earlier and may lay the cloud short.
Spray preferentially when at least this many enemies crowd around the target; 1 means spray on sight.
When on, the companion may leave its post to spray under a Hold order.
